pr_title: [Refactor][DSA][3/N] unified the prefill and decode processes in DSA v1
source_quote:
The tests `test_prefill_and_decode_sas_wrappers_route_phase_specific_inputs` and `test_prefill_and_decode_qli_wrappers_route_decode_output_buffer` are broken and will fail with `AttributeError`. They attempt to call non-existent methods on `AscendDSAMetadataBuilder` (such as `_build_prefill_sas_metadata`, `_build_decode_sas_metadata`, `_build_prefill_qli_metadata`, and `_build_decode_qli_metadata`).
> Since the prefill and decode metadata building processes have been unified into `_build_sas_metadata` and `_build_qli_metadata` (which are already thoroughly tested in the first two test cases), these wrapper-based tests are obsolete, redundant, and truncated at the end of the file. They should be removed.

rule.description: 当重构将多个方法统一为单一方法后，必须同步移除或更新调用旧方法名的测试，否则会导致 `AttributeError` 运行时失败。
checkpoints: 重构统一方法后，搜索测试代码中是否仍有调用旧方法名
确认旧方法已被新方法取代且不再存在
移除或更新所有引用旧方法名的测试用例
确保新测试覆盖统一后的方法逻辑

# tests/ut/attention/test_dsa_v1.py
# 重构后 prefill/decode 已统一为 _build_sas_metadata / _build_qli_metadata
# 但以下测试仍调用旧的 _build_prefill_sas_metadata / _build_decode_sas_metadata 等方法
# 这些方法已不存在，运行时会抛出 AttributeError

    rope_op.assert_called_once()
    assert torch.equal(rope_op.call_args.args[0], input_positions)
    assert rope_op.call_args.kwargs["use_cache"] is (num_prefills == 0)
    assert metadata_cache["cos"] is cos
    assert metadata_cache["sin"] is sin

    # ❌ 以下两个测试调用不存在的方法，会 AttributeError
    def test_prefill_and_decode_sas_wrappers_route_phase_specific_inputs():
        builder = _make_builder()
        # _build_prefill_sas_metadata / _build_decode_sas_metadata 已不存在
        prefill_actual = builder._build_prefill_sas_metadata(...)
        decode_actual = builder._build_decode_sas_metadata(...)

    def test_prefill_and_decode_qli_wrappers_route_decode_output_buffer():
        builder = _make_builder()
        # _build_prefill_qli_metadata / _build_decode_qli_metadata 已不存在
        prefill_actual = builder._build_prefill_qli_metadata(...)
        decode_actual = builder._build_decode_qli_metadata(...)
